meeting_flow.opening_phrase: Hi Michael. How are you? Are you good?... I thought I'd start just by understanding a bit more about sort of your current situation with the property.
rapport_topics: Michael's background as a landlord since 1997
his wider ~40-property portfolio across Nottingham, Chelmsford and London
frustrations with long-let tenancy issues (mould, tenant rights changes)
meeting_flow.pivot_to_business: Yeah. So Nationwide short let management company. Really, we... what we focus on is taking all the moving parts that people normally have when it comes to short-term letting and streamlining that and turning it into a service.
meeting_flow.income_intro: So we've estimated the net revenue for this property... average net per month of about 2,500 pounds.
meeting_flow.how_it_works_transition: I can take you through a bit more about how the service works once, you know, on another sea of what your visibility is like — then walked through dynamic pricing, guest screening, cleaning/maintenance coordination, the owner calendar portal, Slack channel, and monthly statements.
meeting_flow.pre_close_setup: All right, well, I mean, anything else you want to go through, Michael, was it all, you're all happy?
meeting_flow.close_phrase: Well, let's go through the... costing. So we'll get an idea how much I would need to spend — Zac: I'll put that together in an email for you... I'll send over the agreement as well so you can have a look at some of the terms.
meeting_flow.meeting_2_ask: No next meeting explicitly agreed — Zac referenced standard quarterly review calls once live, with no specific date or time set.

lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Finder management company do it for 10? There's quite a lot to do versus regular letting.

zac_language.numbers_framing: Presents a range around an average (worst month ~£1,985-2,000 net, best ~£3,500, averaging ~£2,500/month net), anchored to local competitor data within a 10km radius, and uses review count/rating as evidence of headroom rather than a raw price comparison.
zac_language.objection_handling_pattern: Acknowledges the concern, explains the underlying data or mechanism behind the figure or policy, then reframes toward the upside (e.g. turning the competing guaranteed-rent offer into proof the short-let market is viable) rather than directly refuting the lead's skepticism.

what_they_focused_on: whether the projected income figures are realistic and defensible, not a 'computer churn number'
remote-management logistics given his properties are 150 miles away
the management fee versus his existing 7% long-let rate
key-safe/access security given multiple parties knowing the code
what_they_needed_most: evidence the projected numbers are grounded in real local data, not sales inflation
confirmation Stayful has a genuine track record managing remote/overseas landlords' properties
a negotiated management fee reflecting his portfolio size and existing long-let benchmark
what_fell_flat: The initial framing that short-let return is only 'fractionally better' than long-let didn't land — he read it as fees eroding income to the point of possible loss.
profile_psychology_intersection.recommended_meeting_adjustment: For analytical, numbers-driven portfolio landlords, lead with the competitor-data methodology and remote-landlord track record earlier, and pre-empt the fee-anchored-to-long-let-rate objection by explaining the added service complexity before the lead raises their long-let percentage.
